approved: Tax Laws Amendment (Untainting Tax) (Temporary Budget Repair Levy) Bill 2014
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill is part of a package that introduces a three-year budget repair levy starting in the 2014-15 financial year.
The levy would add two per cent income tax on taxable income over $180,000, with no levy payable on income at or below that threshold except where integrity rules apply.
The levy would also be reflected in tax rates based on the top personal marginal rate, currently 45 per cent, and those based on that rate plus the Medicare levy.
Introduces a temporary budget repair levy as additional income tax on individuals.
Applies the levy at two per cent on taxable income over $180,000.
Adjusts certain tax rates tied to the top personal marginal rate and the Medicare levy.
Australian resident and foreign resident individuals

Introduced the Tax Laws Amendment (Untainting Tax) (Temporary Budget Repair Levy) Bill 2014, amending the Income Tax Assessment Act 1997 to align the corporate untainting tax rate with the new budget repair levy.
